## Research status

**Technical owners.** 7 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Security Kernel and Digital SCIFs](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/security-kernel-and-digital-scifs.html), [Adversarial Machine Learning and the Model Attack Surface](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adversarial-machine-learning-and-model-attack-surface.html), [Privacy, Data Rights, and Information-Flow Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/privacy-data-rights-and-information-flow-governance.html), [Confidential and Verifiable AI Computation](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/confidential-and-verifiable-ai-computation.html), [Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/model-weight-custody-and-hardware-roots-of-trust.html), [Open-Weight Release and Post-Release Control](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/open-weight-release-and-post-release-control.html), [AI Supply-Chain Integrity and Lifecycle Provenance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/ai-supply-chain-integrity-and-lifecycle-provenance.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 23.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Evidence that a materially smaller trusted base preserves confidentiality, integrity, revocation, provenance, and post-release risk at lower burden would narrow the design.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
